logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Horizontal bar chart for the WO-01 verification memo. Four bars, one per candidate (P2, P3, P1, P4 top to bottom), showing measured energy in kWh on the common acceptance-run basis: P2 12 (accent teal), P3 52, P1 56, P4 58 (gray). Candidate labels include gate data as small text (quality index Q, raw defects D). Dashed vertical reference line at P2's bar edge; dashed gap brackets annotate the energy shortfalls of 40, 44 and 46 kWh to P3, P1 and P4. Title: "WO-01 verification: measured energy and gate status". Footnote: all four candidates pass both gates; cost, delivery and reliability unverified. Clean sans-serif, single accent color, no decorative elements.
